name: OlympiadBench
intro: OlympiadBench是一个奥林匹克级别的双语多模态科学基准，包含8476道数学和物理竞赛题目，其中包括中国高考题。该基准配备专家级逐步推理注释，旨在评估大型语言模型和多模态模型的高级能力，以应对传统基准日益严峻的挑战。
build_method: 官方竞赛PDF整理, Mathpix OCR与人工校核, 专家解答和标签标注
metric: Accuracy（数值与符号等价自动评分）
modality: 文本, 图像, 多模态
task_type: 数学问题, 开放式问答, 定理证明
eval_feature: 双语, 多模态, 专家级逐步解答, 数值与符号等价判分
task_type_en: Math Problems, Open-ended QA, Theorem Proving
build_method_en: Official Competition PDFs, Mathpix OCR and Manual Verification, Expert Solutions and Labels
eval_feature_en: Bilingual, multimodal, expert step-by-step solutions, numeric and symbolic equivalence scoring
intro_en: OlympiadBench is an Olympiad-level bilingual multimodal science benchmark containing 8,476 math and physics competition problems, including Chinese Gaokao questions. It features expert-level step-by-step reasoning annotations and aims to evaluate the advanced capabilities of large language models and multimodal models in addressing the increasing challenges of traditional benchmarks.
metric_en: Accuracy with automatic numeric and symbolic equivalence scoring

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2402.14008 and the official OpenBMB/OlympiadBench repository. The diagrams preserve collection from global math and physics Olympiads, Chinese regional/national competitions, and Gaokao/mock exams; official PDF acquisition; Mathpix OCR to Markdown with embedded images; manual source comparison and scientific-notation repair; Problem-Solution-Answer structuring with expert reasoning; math-language-model embeddings and cosine-similarity deduplication; manual topic, subfield, and open/theorem-proof labels; progressive physics context preservation; definitive answer types; bilingual multimodal prompt construction; the 8,476-problem release with 100% solutions, 6,728 open-ended and 1,748 theorem-proving problems, and 4,869 image-bearing problems; numeric tolerance at 1e-8, equation normalization, element checks, and SymPy equivalence. Theorem-proof results are kept separate because the official automatic scorer does not cover them.
